fluid_domain.evidence: Fluid network only (not the column range): the ideal-gas Cp fit range, from max(ChemSep Cp data start, triple point) to 900 K; below it Cp is held and integrated, with a notice (a data-range end, never a validity floor). 100 Pa..2000000 Pa as the bundled light ends: PR78 from ChemSep critical constants, not qualified above that.
